title: Ovarian cancer cell line landscape
projectDescription: Nine ovarian cancer cell lines were analyzed using phosphoproteomics and proteomics. The KURAMOCHI cell line was further subjected to treatment with the drug C26A6 and transfection with siRNA towards MTDH and SND1.
sampleProcessingProtocol: Cells were lysed using boling lysis buffer (5% SDS, 0.1M TRIS ph8.5, 10 mM 2-CAA) and transferred to low binding tubes before 2 min sonication. Protein Aggregation Capture was performed in a KingFisher Flex system with MagResyn hydroxyl beads, with disgestion using LysC 1:500 and trypsin 1:250 (w/w). Peptides were desalted using SepPak tC18 cartridge columns. For phosphoenrichment Ti-IMAC HP beads (Resyn Biosciences) were used in the KingFisher Flex system. Peptides were loaded on Evotips before analysis.
dataProcessingProtocol: DIA raw files were converted to mzML using msconvert of Proteowizard with vendor peakpicking and demultiplexing (when staggered DIA windows had been used). DIA-NN in library free mode was used for identification and quantification. 1 missed cleavage was used and human UniProtKB as of May 2022. For full proteome samples no variable modifications were used. For the phosphoenriched samples one variable Phospo (STY) was set for the cell line landscape data nad two variable modifications for the treatment and transfection data.

references.referenceLine: Esmaeili P, Nasimian A, Werner L, Junior SM, Jakobsson ME, Gerdtsson AS, Kazi JU, Levander F. Proteomics discovery of MTDH and SND1 interaction vulnerabilities in ovarian cancer. Sci Rep. 2025 15(1):41818
